I experiment with (manually) arguing with the bot here.

I'm reasonably sure I'm right on this one (though I might be wrong because of lack of experience with mathlib). Would be nice if there's a bypass button (at least for mathlib maintainers).
I suppose I can simulate the reviewer locally to see what prompt it would accept (if I have tokens) :thinking:. Technically is not cheating? Or is it?
I can't imagine that many humans let alone maintainers are going to be looking at these PR reviews. But what's useful is to see where we can improve the rubrics

I can't imagine that many humans [...] are going to be looking at these PR reviews

true.

see where we can improve the rubrics

also true. But this implies “someone” need to look at some part of the progress regardless
Yeah I think this is something we need to audit to see where we can make things better. I have plans to do this soon, but data points like this are useful.
